title: Build a recipe in layers

scenes.heading: Where did this setting come from?
scenes.sub: Start with a value in the resolved recipe
voice: You see a component setting in a resolved recipe and want to know why it has that value.
Follow the layers that produced the configuration.

scenes.heading: Build up the environment
scenes.sub: Start broad, then apply more detail
voice: Start with base settings, then layer in service and accelerator configuration.
A more specific overlay can change a value that an earlier shared overlay defined.

scenes.heading: Bring in shared requirements
scenes.sub: Several leaves can reuse one mixin
voice: A mixin can carry a reusable fragment, such as Ubuntu requirements or a workload platform component.
Different recipe leaves can pull in the same fragment instead of copying its definition.

scenes.heading: Read the path to the answer
scenes.sub: Find the exact recipe and its parent layers
voice: Use recipe list to find the supported leaf and then resolve it.
Read the applied overlays recorded in metadata and trace the final component value back through that chain.

payoff: Trace a setting through recipe overlays and a reusable mixin, then use the resolved inheritance chain to identify its source.
